sharedPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: static open-source directory card artwork for a personal brand website. Style: premium editorial 3D still life, warm ivory studio background, soft natural light, tactile materials, deep navy with restrained copper accents. Landscape 4:3 composition; center the still life with breathing room and keep key objects within the central 75 percent. One still image, not an animation storyboard or multiple panels. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, people, mascots, or software screenshots. The reference image guides only card illustration scale and clarity; do not copy its characters, dog, or palette.
